en: Sepia-toned historic postcard depicting the courtyard and portico of a large church or mosque-like building with arched colonnades. A crowd of people, many in traditional robes and hats, gathers in front of the arches. In the foreground there is a rectangular stone fountain or sarcophagus, and a large tree at the right edge. The architecture includes a tall vertical element resembling a bell tower or minaret. The style and clothing suggest an early 20th‑century scene in southeastern Europe or the eastern Mediterranean. A web address "www.elia.org.gr" is printed across the bottom right.
